description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Software Engineer Intern on the Ad Creatives team in our Tel Aviv office, you’ll work on large-scale systems that power advertising across the open web. You’ll develop software used by thousands of websites and reach more than 1.4B users, while working alongside experienced engineers on high-scale, real-time systems and seeing the impact of your work almost immediately.

To thrive in this role, you'll need:

- BSc in Computer Science or equivalent, with strong Computer Science fundamentals including object-oriented design, data structures, systems and multithreading

- Programming experience in Java or another object-oriented programming language

- Knowledge of SQL, data analysis and Big Data concepts

- Experience or academic/project experience with large-scale distributed systems

- Experience with Generative AI coding tools

Bonus points if you have:

- Experience with Big Data technologies such as Spark or Kafka

- Experience with cloud, containerization or distributed systems technologies

How you’ll make an impact:

- Develop software components and infrastructure supporting thousands of websites and more than 1.4B users across the open web

- Build and maintain high-scale, real-time systems handling more than 500,000 requests per second and generating 100TB of new data every day

- Collaborate with experienced software engineers and product managers to design and deliver new features

- Work with CI/CD, A/B testing and large-scale data to develop, test and improve production systems

- Work with technologies including Java, Spark, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, BigQuery, Airflow and other modern data and infrastructure tools

- Analyze system performance and use data to improve the reliability, scalability and efficiency of our solutions

Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

- Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO: “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.”

- Well-being: Competitive benefits and well-being programs tailored to the region, including comprehensive health benefits, a fully stocked kitchen, and location-specific perks.

- Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office, with an option to come in more often if desired.

- Work with some of the biggest names: Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, and Expedia.

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog.

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

description:
Company:
Qualcomm Israel Ltd.

Job Area:
Interns Group, Interns Group > Engineering Intern

General Summary:

About the Team

Our team develops advanced communication systems for research, testing, and validation. We work with industry standards such as 5G, as well as custom communication specifications and waveforms.

The team owns the complete development lifecycle, building systems from the ground up. This includes algorithm development, system and FPGA architecture, Verilog/SystemVerilog implementation, embedded C software, functional verification, hardware integration, and end-to-end laboratory validation.

Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated undergraduate or graduate student to join our FPGA development team and contribute to the development, integration, and testing of FPGA-based communication systems.

The position involves RTL development using Verilog or SystemVerilog, FPGA implementation with AMD/Xilinx Vivado, MATLAB-based modeling and verification, and embedded C development with Vitis for MicroBlaze and ARM processors.

The student will gain hands-on experience with advanced FPGA evaluation platforms such as VPK180, RFSoC, Versal, Zynq, or similar boards. The work includes FPGA development, hardware/software integration, board bring-up, laboratory testing, and system-level debugging.

We are looking for a curious, hands-on student with strong learning abilities, good problem-solving skills, and an interest in FPGA technology and communication systems.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, simulate, and verify FPGA logic using Verilog or SystemVerilog.

- Build and maintain FPGA projects using AMD/Xilinx Vivado.

- Develop and debug embedded C applications using Vitis for MicroBlaze and ARM processors.

- Use MATLAB for algorithm modeling, signal analysis, test-vector generation, and verification.

- Develop RTL testbenches and perform functional verification, simulation, waveform analysis, and debugging.

- Work with VPK180, RFSoC, Versal, Zynq, or similar FPGA evaluation platforms.

- Support board bring-up, hardware/software integration, testing, and system-level debugging.

- Perform laboratory measurements, analyze results, and investigate technical issues.

- Document designs, interfaces, test procedures, and technical findings.

- Collaborate with FPGA, software, algorithm, DSP, RF, and system engineers.

Required Qualifications

- Currently pursuing a BSc or MSc degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

- Knowledge of Verilog or SystemVerilog and fundamental digital-design concepts.

- Familiarity with AMD/Xilinx Vivado.

- Working knowledge of MATLAB.

- Basic or advanced C programming skills.

- Basic understanding of embedded software development.

- Basic knowledge of digital communication systems.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and learning skills.

- Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering team.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AMD/Xilinx Vitis and embedded C development for MicroBlaze or ARM processors.

- Hands-on experience with VPK180, RFSoC, Versal, Zynq, or similar FPGA platforms.

- Knowledge of digital signal processing, PHY algorithms, RF, or wireless communication systems.

- Familiarity with AXI interfaces and hardware/software integration.

- Familiarity with 1 Gigabit Ethernet and 100 Gigabit Ethernet, including AMD/Xilinx CMAC/DCMAC IP cores, Ethernet MAC/PCS functions, and high-speed transceivers.

- Hands-on experience with RTL testbench development, functional verification, simulation, waveform analysis, and debugging.

- Experience with laboratory equipment such as spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.

Minimum Qualifications

- Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate technical degree program.

- Knowledge of Verilog or SystemVerilog, MATLAB, and C.

- Basic understanding of FPGA technology and communication systems.

*References to a particular number of years experience are for indicative purposes only. Applications from candidates with equivalent experience will be considered, provided that the candidate can demonstrate an ability to fulfill the principal duties of the role and possesses the required competencies.
